name: story-tenant-theme
title: Tenant theme story
description: Dot animation of a dashboard switching between tenant themes.
usage: Per-tenant theming on a site card or product hero. Plays only on screen; shows the first tenant's theme with reduced motion.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
